<style lang="scss" scoped>
@use 'sass:math';

@function randomNum($min, $max) {
  $randomNum: $min + math.random() * ($max - $min);
  @return $randomNum;
}

:where(.canvas) {
  --text-color: #f6f1e6;
  --drops-color: #231d1c;
}

.canvas {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;

  &--animated {
    .puddle__letter {
      animation-play-state: running;
    }
  }
}

.puddle {
  position: absolute;
  display: flex;
  transform: rotate(var(--r, 0deg))
    translate(calc(-50% - var(--x, 0)), calc(-50% - var(--y, 0)));
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  color: var(--text-color);
  font-size: 6vmin;
  white-space: pre;

  &__letter {
    transform: translateY(800px);
    padding: 0.1em 0.2em;
    margin: -0.1em -0.2em;
    will-change: transform;
    animation: drop 0.8s var(--delay) ease-out forwards paused;
  }
}

.combined-puddles {
  position: relative;
  height: 100%;
  z-index: -1;
  filter: url(#drops-filter);
  user-select: none;

  .puddle__letter {
    border-radius: 50%;
    color: var(--drops-color);
    background-color: currentColor;

    @for $i from 1 through 10 {
      &--t-#{$i} {
        box-shadow: #{randomNum(-0.03, 0.03)}em
          #{randomNum(-0.03, 0.03)}em
          0
          #{randomNum(0.2, 0.4)}em
          currentColor;
      }
    }
  }
}

@keyframes drop {
  0% {
    transform: translate(0, 100vh);
  }
  85% {
    transform: translate(0, -0.15em);
  }
  100% {
    transform: translate(0, 0);
  }
}
</style>
